convoy.title: A narrow departure
convoy.briefing: A cutter is shadowing our convoy. Cover a departure attempt, or finance the broker's safe-passage deal.
convoy.commitment: Accepting cover starts a 180-second departure window. Disable the cutter before it closes. The timer continues if you leave this world. Retreat is possible; a broken commitment costs 4 relations.

defend.label: Cover their departure
defend.hint: 180 seconds to disable the Rake cutter. Success: 90 Marks and +12 consortium relations. Failure or abandonment: −4 relations.

passage.label: Underwrite safe passage
passage.hint: Approach within 12 m; pay 60 Marks. +8 consortium relations, no cash reward. The payment protects the convoy, not your ship.
passage.detail: −60 Marks · Consortium +8 · cutter stays hostile to you

decline.label: Decline involvement
decline.hint: The convoy stays behind. No cost or relationship penalty; this offer closes permanently.

defend.summary: The cutter is disabled. The convoy makes its departure and pays your escort fee.

passage.summary: The convoy buys a departure corridor. The cutter still threatens other ships, including yours.

failed.summary: The promised departure window closes. The convoy turns back and its broker records your broken commitment.

declined.summary: You declined the escort request. The convoy remains outside your protection.

convoy.summary: Your escort commitment starts a 180-second window. Leaving does not stop its clock.

registry.title: Who owns the silence?
registry.briefing: A derelict buoy bears conflicting salvage claims. Scan it, then publish the evidence or sell exclusive rights. A sentry guards the site.
registry.commitment: Scan within 12 m for six uninterrupted simulation seconds: 8 energy per attempt. Moving away, changing orders or being towed breaks the scan. Inspection pauses it. Decide what to do with the evidence afterward.

inspect.label: Approach and scan the buoy
inspect.hint: 8 energy per scan attempt. Six seconds within 12 m; the local sentry remains a real threat.
inspect.detail: 8 energy per attempt · hold within 12 m · sentry remains dangerous

publish.label: Publish the competing claims
publish.hint: 20 Marks survey stipend; Commune +12, Directorate −6. Makes the evidence public; excludes the private sale.

license.label: Sell an exclusive warrant
license.hint: 100 Marks; Directorate +10, Commune −8. Grants the claimant exclusive evidence; excludes public release.

decline.label: Leave the registry alone
decline.hint: No relationship penalty. Closes this opportunity; scan energy already spent is not refunded.

publish.summary: You publish the conflicting seals. Independent claimants can challenge ownership, angering the Directorate's claimant.

license.summary: You sell exclusive evidence to the Directorate claimant. Commune observers condemn the closed proceeding.

declined.summary: You leave the ownership dispute unresolved. No one receives your evidence.

registry.summary: Close-range scan: 8 energy, six seconds. Move or change orders to interrupt; inspection pauses.
